hook: Cancer cells resistant to PARP inhibitors lean on ISG15, and blocking it restores drug sensitivity
hook_turn: and blocking it restores drug sensitivity
summary: Drugs called PARP inhibitors work on BRCA1-mutant tumors until resistance appears. In resistant cell lines and patient-derived xenografts, the immune gene ISG15 was turned up and helped cells copy and repair DNA; inhibiting it re-sensitized cells, and TP53BP1 loss also arose. The evidence is from cell and mouse models, not patients.
title: ISG15 promotes PARP inhibitor resistance in BRCA1-deficient cells by facilitating DNA replication and repair
